apps.name: RagaMentor
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.35 — Transport response at slow speeds: an output gate now sits after the pitch unit. Pause, stop and restart mute the output within ~10 ms, so the stretched tail the pitch unit holds no longer plays on after you tap — pause and the loop-name restart feel instant even at 0.25x.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.
